text: Operations recorded lazily list steps. User-facing op types: filter, head, tail, sample, distinct, join, spat_relate. Never reaches .ptabular_apply_op. id_filter internal op type created ephemerally spat_relate narrow path cache surviving ids across chained spat_relate ops. arrow handler (.ptabular_apply_op “id_filter” → semi_join) SQL handler (.pstore_sql_inner “id_filter” → correlated EXISTS subquery). @post_ops holds R-level post-materialization ops Arrow equivalent. Currently one type: "transform" (affine2d). crop()/window<- may inject "filter" half-plane op @ops rotation/shear pending — plain Arrow filter op injected .pgeom_resolve_extent(), post-op.

Arrow equivalent applied materialized result .apply_post_ops(). output = "query" unaffected. spatial transform verbs (spin, rescale, shear, spatShift, t, flip, affine) collapse result single affine2d entry — matter many chained, one transform stored time. Back-projection crop/window: transform pending, crop() window<- back-project query extent inverse transform intrinsic (-disk) space recording @crop/@window. rotation/shear, exact half-plane filter also injected @ops Arrow-native inequality filter x_index/y_index. Axis-aligned transforms need AABB.

title: Architecture and Design
text: parquetGeomTileStore adds two slots beyond parquetGeomStore: @tiles (tilePlan) — full tile plan used write time; tile maps hive directory tile_index=/. @tile_filter (integer) — set tile indices overlap current @crop. Empty (integer(0)) crop set. crop(parquetGeomTileStore, y) first calls parent crop(parquetGeomBase, y), handles affine back-projection composes @crop intrinsic space. selects query region tile intersection: transform pending: @crop already exact intrinsic-space extent — tilework::intersect(x@tiles, terra::ext(x@crop)) used directly.
